references.text: Micah prophesies judgment on those who bear no fruit, mirroring Jesus' action with the fig tree.
Isaiah uses the fig tree as a symbol for people who bear no fruit, parallel to Jesus' condemnation of the fig tree.
Jeremiah warns that those who do not listen to God's word will become like a dry tree, similar to the withered fig tree.
The parable of the fig tree that bears no fruit and is given one last chance, parallel to Jesus' action with the fig tree.
The psalm describes the righteous as fruitful trees, in contrast to the unfruitful fig tree.
